module_summary: AXI-Lite clock-domain-crossing bridge: structural wrapper splitting traffic into a write-channel CDC child (aw/w/b) and a read-channel CDC child (ar/r).

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave-side write address valid starting a write crossing in write CDC child.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Slave-side write data carried across to master domain.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave-side read address valid starting a read crossing in read CDC child.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave domain from read CDC child.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave-side write address forwarded to write CDC.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Slave-side read address forwarded to read CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master-side write address valid issued by write CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Master-side write address issued in m_clk domain.

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Master-side write data issued by write CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master-side read address valid issued by read CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Master-side read address issued in m_clk domain.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Master-side read data captured by read CDC.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Write address ready back to slave from write CDC.

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: Write data ready back to slave from write CDC.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid to slave, returned across domains.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Read address ready back to slave from read CDC.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid to slave from read CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master-side write response valid captured by write CDC.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Master-side read data valid captured by read CDC.

groups.name: write_channel_cdc
groups.description: Write CDC child crossing aw/w from s_clk to m_clk and b response back.

groups.name: read_channel_cdc
groups.description: Read CDC child crossing ar from s_clk to m_clk and r data back.
